(1) Re-voiced per done:3 (above). (2) KIT_SLOTS now include 'hit' and 'dash'. case 'hit' (index.ts:1279-1283) plays f_<id>_hit before the ability's hitSfx. case 'dash' (:1335) plays f_<id>_dash unless the unit was knocked airborne that same tick. In src/sim/movement.ts:252-269, displaceUnit applies airborne (never tenacity-reduced) before emitting the dash, and all 17 displace ops have a duration of 0.2-0.75 s, so the rule holds; none displaces the caster itself. probe_audio_kits (fw_W3_v2_kits.log) reproduces the refix run exactly: 16/16 kitted, every ability hit -> f_<id>_hit, every own dash -> f_<id>_dash, every displacement -> c_dash, and K1-K5 hold. K6 tells a displacement from a dash by the dash event's vfx key, independently of the engine's rule. The build.py kit gate requires both new slots for all 16, own and never shared; hits are distance-gated (min 8.18 / 8.23). Ability hits lose <= 1.2 LU and attack hits <= 2.02 LU through the 220 Hz high-pass (fw_W3_v2_impact_kits.json). Physical attack hits now carry a contact of 0.091-0.518 against a 0.07 floor (the round-1 AUD-4 regression is fixed). Kit cue loudness moved only -0.46..+0.74 LU against bb0a3f7d, with peaks <= -1.16 dBFS (fw_W3_v2_kit_loudness_delta.json). (3) take() (index.ts:609) draws from the other n-1 takes, so the same take never plays twice in a row. K7 counts 0 back-to-back repeats in 8 runs. Remaining minors: the 16 own dashes are near-identical by spectrum: 25 of 120 pairs are under 8 dB on the review metric (min 2.17, burdam/hesmi) and 30 on the 125 Hz metric (min 2.48). DASH_AIR puts burdam, hesmi, marund and tunlan in overlapping 220-1200 Hz bands (audio/cues/kits_c.py:98-101). The dash is gated for ownership only. Projectiles still share c_proj_whoosh (index.ts case 'projectile'). Neither was in AUD-1's original fix list.
items.fixHint: Follow-up (minor): gate f_*_dash in DIST_SLOTS and spread DASH_AIR / the signature layer for the low-band fighters. A per-fighter projectile slot would close the last shared combat cue.
